meta.title: Set release LTO to thin
meta.body_summary: Switch release LTO from fat to thin to reduce build time, providing benchmark data showing ~2x build time reduction with minimal runtime performance impact.

perf_labels.notes: Simple Cargo.toml change from fat to thin LTO; author provided build time and runtime IPC/wallclock data; approved and merged via Graphite queue.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At only 2 changed lines in a single Cargo.toml, this is a trivial build configuration edit. It is typical for a low-risk performance build optimization and the merge outcome aligns with small change scope.

review_details.concern_detail: No explicit concerns raised; maintainer approved after review of the provided benchmark data.
review_details.performance_claim: Switching from fat to thin LTO approximately halves build time (from 72s to 35s) with minimal runtime performance impact (0.5% IPC improvement, 0.7% fewer instructions, 0.8% wallclock improvement).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A simple one-line config change in Cargo.toml; the agent merely proposed the change based on Codex's benchmarking, and the author validated it. Merge was straightforward with no technical hurdles.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer jimpo reviewed the PR and approved without comments, presumably accepting the benchmark data provided by the author.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Author measured build time and runtime performance on a Keccak example with fat vs thin LTO, reporting IPC, instructions, and wallclock; data is numeric and plausible.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No adverse performance effects noted; minimal runtime improvement with large build time gains.

core_change_summary.description: In Cargo.toml, changed [profile.release] lto from "fat" to "thin".
change_trajectory: Single commit: set release LTO to thin in Cargo.toml.
